sentences.text: Clause 7.4 does not comply with the applicable RBI/UCB pre-payment rule for floating-rate loans to individuals for non-business purposes because it says foreclosure charges of 2% plus GST shall be levied on all term loans pre-closed by the borrower, while the in-force UCB direction says such loans shall not levy pre-payment charges.
The 2026 UCB direction applies to loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026, and the question says the loan was sanctioned in 2026.
The record does not provide the exact sanction date, so the date scope was not fully verified from the evidence.

missing.searched: Checked the UCB pre-payment directions for sanction/renewal timing and the case facts, but no exact loan sanction date was provided.
